$description: Semantic colour. Values reference scale steps for the active appearance: {gray.12}, {gray.a3}, {accent.9}. {accent.*} is the brand scale (moss by default) and is what tenant theming replaces. {dark:moss.9} pins an appearance. alpha({ref}, n) sets opacity. 'value' applies to every theme; keys named after a theme or its parent override it.

surface.$description: Primary surface: panels, cards, table body, main column.

surface-nested.$description: A quieter layer inside a surface: table headers, nested panels, sidebars within cards.

raised.$description: Floating surfaces: menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs. Always paired with an elevation.

sunken.$description: Wells below the surface: code blocks, drop zones, inset inputs.

hover.$description: Neutral hover tint over any surface.

selected.$description: Selected rows, chosen options, current nav item inside content.

brand.$description: Brand fill for marks and hero moments.

brand-soft.$description: Quiet brand wash: onboarding, highlighted cards.

layer.$description: Stacking layers. Aliases of the bg roles so the Carbon-style layer vocabulary maps onto Faun paper surfaces. Nest at most three deep; see ADR 0005.

background.$description: Page ground. Equivalent to layer-00 / background.

01.$description: First layer on the ground: panels, cards, table body.

02.$description: A layer inside layer 01: table headers, nested panels, sidebars within cards.

03.$description: The deepest layer: wells inside layer 02 (code blocks, drop zones, inset inputs). On warm paper a third nesting step reads as inset, not lifted.

accent.$description: Quiet brand wash layered on any surface.

hover.$description: Neutral hover tint over any layer.

muted.$description: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, column headers. Lowest tier for readable text (≥ 4.5:1).

subtle.$description: Non-essential marks only: decorative icons, separators in text. ≥ 3:1. Never body text.

control.$description: Input, select, checkbox and radio outlines. ≥ 3:1 against surface and canvas (WCAG 1.4.11).

ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px offset. ≥ 3:1 against canvas and surface.

halo.$description: Soft halo outside the ring for text inputs.

accent.$description: Interaction matrix for the brand intent. Buttons, toggles, chips and links compose from these.

solid-bg.$description: Fill of the brand solid button and other high-emphasis controls.

solid-bg-hover.$description: Hovered and pressed brand solid fill.

solid-fg.$description: Label and icon on the brand solid fill.

soft-bg.$description: Tinted fill for brand soft controls: chips, selected toggles, soft buttons.

soft-bg-active.$description: Pressed or selected brand soft fill.

ghost-bg-hover.$description: Hover tint for brand ghost controls (no resting fill).

ghost-bg-active.$description: Pressed tint for brand ghost controls.

fg.$description: Text and icon colour for brand ghost, outline and link controls.

neutral.$description: Interaction matrix for the neutral intent. The default secondary button is neutral outline.

solid-bg.$description: Fill of the neutral solid button and other high-emphasis controls.

solid-bg-hover.$description: Hovered and pressed neutral solid fill.

solid-fg.$description: Label and icon on the neutral solid fill.

soft-bg.$description: Tinted fill for neutral soft controls: chips, selected toggles, soft buttons.

soft-bg-active.$description: Pressed or selected neutral soft fill.

outline-bg.$description: Surface fill behind neutral outline controls (the default secondary button).

ghost-bg-hover.$description: Hover tint for neutral ghost controls (no resting fill).

ghost-bg-active.$description: Pressed tint for neutral ghost controls.

fg.$description: Text and icon colour for neutral ghost, outline and link controls.

fg-muted.$description: Quieter neutral ghost label, e.g. Cancel. Brightens on hover.

solid-bg.$description: Fill of the destructive solid button and other high-emphasis controls.

solid-bg-hover.$description: Hovered and pressed destructive solid fill.

solid-fg.$description: Label and icon on the destructive solid fill.

soft-bg.$description: Tinted fill for destructive soft controls: chips, selected toggles, soft buttons.

soft-bg-active.$description: Pressed or selected destructive soft fill.

ghost-bg-hover.$description: Hover tint for destructive ghost controls (no resting fill).

ghost-bg-active.$description: Pressed tint for destructive ghost controls.

fg.$description: Text and icon colour for destructive ghost, outline and link controls.

status.$description: Seven tones. Always icon + label, never colour alone. fg: text/icons. bg: tinted container. border: container outline. solid: strong fill. on-solid: text on solid.

fg.$description: Neutral: text and icons for this tone on any surface.

on-solid.$description: Neutral: text on the strong fill.

fg.$description: Running: text and icons for this tone on any surface.

bg.$description: Running: tinted container: badges, banners, table cells.

ai.$description: Machine-generated content. Lagoon marks machine activity (running, generated); plum marks people (attention). AI content keeps this marker until a person accepts it.

fg.$description: AI label, sparkle and generated-content text accents.

bg.$description: Wash behind AI-generated content awaiting acceptance.

mark-start.$description: Sparkle and generated-content rule gradient start.

sidebar.$description: Open application navigation panel (ADR 0011). A light paper surface in light themes and a theme-appropriate dark surface in dark themes, so it sits on the page the way the main column does. The collapsed icon rail is a separate near-black surface, see `rail`. Primary actions inside the panel use the ordinary accent solid button.

fg-muted.$description: Section labels, counts, workspace context, chevrons.

fg-active.$description: Current and hovered item label, workspace and user names.

accent.$description: Current-item indicator bar, pinned dot, progress bar and focus ring on the panel.

badge-bg.$description: Attention badge and dot on the panel.

mark-fg.$description: Logo on the workspace mark tile.

rail.$description: Collapsed icon rail (ADR 0011): near-black in every theme, so the rail reads as a fixed spine whether the panel beside it is light or dark. Text is white at set opacities, composited and contrast-tested on the surface and on the hover and active fills. Printed output keeps the rail as is.

bg.$description: Rail surface. A literal ink, #17171a, because no gray-scale step is this dark and cool-neutral.

accent.$description: Current-item indicator and focus ring on the rail.

mark-bg.$description: Workspace mark tile on the rail.

mark-fg.$description: Logo on the workspace mark tile on the rail.

action-bg.$description: The '+' primary action square on the rail: the brand moss.

action-border.$description: Hairline around the '+' action so it separates from the ink.

nav.$description: Deprecated alias of the sidebar group (same values); use sidebar.* in new code.

dataviz.$description: Charts only. Re-derived from Faun's own scales (src/scales/viz.json, scripts/viz.ts): slot 1 is the brand moss, then lagoon, ochre, plum, oxblood, blue, grass and warm grey. Validated for colour-vision deficiency; assign in order, never cycle.

cat-1.$description: Categorical series slot 1: brand moss (the brand solid step). Assign in order.

cat-2.$description: Categorical series slot 2: lagoon. Assign in order.

cat-3.$description: Categorical series slot 3: ochre. Assign in order.

cat-4.$description: Categorical series slot 4: plum. Assign in order.

cat-5.$description: Categorical series slot 5: oxblood. Assign in order.

cat-6.$description: Categorical series slot 6: blue. Assign in order.

cat-7.$description: Categorical series slot 7: grass. Assign in order.

cat-8.$description: Categorical series slot 8: warm grey (always last). Assign in order.
